note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is given with characters and measurements, and neither the worker nor the alate is described for this species; synonymy, figure numbers, type locality and nomenclatural remarks are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, oval; outline nearly straight, only slightly raised at the base of the nasus; vertex with 2 setae, the base of the nasus with few or no setae; antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 4, segment 4 longer than or about equal to segment 2; mandibles with distinct points; nasus darker than the head, medium in length and thickness; anterior margin of the pronotum slightly notched; abdominal tergites covered with very fine hairs and with a few short setae, especially towards the posterior end of the abdomen. Measurements (mm): head length 1.50, head width 0.85, antennal length 1.53, pronotal width 0.47, hind tibia length 0.93.
